Numerical deviations of the model from the measurements of Ag-110m
Register rows of Ag-110m (including rows labelled with the element only): 175; 119 digitised from published figures (labelled digitised, with their reading uncertainty), 56 tabulated or
printed and exact as printed.
Comparison status of these rows: DATA INCOMPLETE 5; NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE 165; EXCEEDS REPORTED UPPER BOUND 5.
NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE because the measured quantity is not the model quantity: 29 x deposition_cup_history (deposition-cup collection); 52 x failed_or_released_particles (failed SiC or
releasing particle); 1 x fuel_sphere (fuel sphere of a benchmark); 32 x includes_in_pile_inventory (total includes in-pile inventory); 22 x irradiation_phase_quantity (irradiation-phase
inventory location); 16 x loose_particles_with_failures (loose particles including failed ones); 2 x mixed_particles (mixture of failed and intact particles); 11 x other_fuel_batch (AGR-2
fuel).

No Ag-110m row supports a point comparison, so the absolute deviation, the relative deviation in percent and the log-space root-mean-square deviation are not defined for Ag-110m; no number
is substituted.

Experimental values: Collin et al. (2016); IAEA (1997); IAEA (2012); Morris et al. (2016); Stempien et al. (2023). Only the rows whose status supports a comparison are drawn in colour; rows that are NOT DIRECTLY

COMPARABLE are muted grey context, because they measure another quantity than the model computes (failed particles, totals that include release in the reactor, another fuel, fuel spheres). A bar on a marker is the

reading uncertainty of the register (the error of reading the point off the published figure); it is not a measurement uncertainty, and the sources report no per-value measurement uncertainty for these rows (a

general 5 percent systematic gamma-measurement error stated for the Stempien 2023 values is not a per-value uncertainty and changes no status), so no other error bar is drawn. Compact values are not single-particle

values; rows at a temperature outside 1600 to 1800 °C or whose value is not a fraction are not drawn. Analytical-series values are drawn only where the criterion holds: a value of the independent analytical series

is exported only where (1) the time is not earlier than the series' own minimum valid time (omitted modes below exp(-40) of their weight) and (2) the value exceeds the series' estimated absolute accuracy (about

2.2e-16 over the smallest flux ratio of the shooting solution), and is positive; otherwise it is left empty. The early part of every BTCS curve is not converged in time: where the release is still rising steeply

from zero, the base run and the run with half the step differ by a large factor, and the report states for each curve the time after which they agree within 10 percent (a reading aid, not a tolerance). Model: STRATO

BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit b6331621ca70dc453e6856bdd1263bf61c15260b; registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients chosen by the

strato-data selection function (register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start; constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical
comparison, not an experimental validation.
